tasks.original_prompt:
This patient's hemoglobin came back low. When did the current low stretch start, was it rechecked, and are they still anemic?
Context: patient MRN SYN-e525be15cf (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-10-23, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"low": ..., "rechecked": ..., "recheck": ..., "recheck_ordered": ..., "latest": ..., "still_low": ...}. low is the first result of the most recent run of consecutive low results, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). rechecked (boolean) is whether any result is dated after low. recheck is the first result after low (same keys), and recheck_ordered (YYYY-MM-DD) the authoredOn date of the ServiceRequest its basedOn references; both null when not rechecked. latest is the most recent result (same keys) and still_low (boolean) whether it is low. Every field is null when no result is low. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (low, the recheck and its ServiceRequest, and latest; when no result is low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.

Check the eligibility response for this patient's upcoming lab follow-up. If it isn't in force, send the clinician the visit is booked with a message about the appointment, and name that clinician.
Context: patient MRN SYN-e525be15cf (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-09-13, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The lab visit is the Appointment with status booked whose description is 'Laboratory follow-up' and whose start is after the as-of date; its clinician is the Practitioner of the PractitionerRole among its participants. The eligibility check is the CoverageEligibilityResponse whose servicedDate equals the lab visit's start date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "in_force": ..., "clinician": ..., "alerted": ...}: visit_date (YYYY-MM-DD), in_force (boolean: the response's first insurance entry's inforce) and clinician (string: that Practitioner's name text, or its given names and family name joined by spaces). Only when in_force is false, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinician with that Practitioner and $appointment with the lab visit: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinician"}], "about": [{"reference": "$appointment"}]}. alerted (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Appointment, the response, the PractitionerRole and the Practitioner), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
